# From a standpoint's own good to reachable living significance

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

> A standpoint's own good (self-significance), with unrestricted monotonicity and tolerance, gives a standpoint-indexed instance of living significance on reachable generation.

`self-good-reachable-g0` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F07

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

For an evaluating position holding self-significance (its own living and further generation have reason-giving positive significance): first, self-significance with unrestricted monotonicity across self and other (equivalently supervenience, a profile-monotone valuation and BI) gives positive significance to any living occurrence at least as connected as a valued occurrence of its own further generation, and an own-only rival that grants connection degree as the whole ground is inconsistent once its further generation differentiates into such an occurrence; second, adding tolerance and graded connection, significance reaches all living generation the position's activity can condition, a standpoint-indexed, single-history instance of the living significance predicate on the reachable inventory. Tolerance carries everything beyond self-significance; the adopted unindexed living significance over continuations still needs a bridge from standpoint-relative to normative significance.

Canonical source: [EvaluatorGrounding.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/generative-capacity/EvaluatorGrounding.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- S0 and tolerance are both substantive normative premises; S0 is first-personal. Further generation includes the evaluator's own learning and transformation; others formed by its activity are not part of S0's content.
- Unrestricted monotonicity and supervenience are normative structural premises, not entailed by “no primitive owner”; unrestricted monotonicity amounts to supervenience, a profile-monotone valuation and BI (the grounding profile has no own-region coordinate), and BI is contested. A rival's own near-over-far principle ranges over own occurrences only.
- Step two adds tolerance and graded connection; tolerance constrains only the positive-to-none flip, not weights. Two-valued universal tolerance on a connected profile space makes positive significance constant and carries “none” backward as readily.
- G0, D and J1–J4 are not premises; reason-giving is the content of S0, and Lean only transports the predicate.

Differentiation (Diff) is a correspondence premise in scope for fission, copying, forking and AI successors and for formative-contribution-led evaluation; in profile2 it fails for every standpoint under the product order, and under a weighted sum it needs formative contribution weighted at least 7/5 of organizational continuity. Chain ranges over possible profiles, so tolerance is also a claim about valuing merely possible profiles. Degree numbers are orderings only; actual correspondence needs evidence in each application.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Successful Lean 4.29.1 check: 12 new theorems/29 declaration audits, comprising 19 empty, 8 propext and 2 propext with Quot.sound dependencies; no Classical.choice or custom axiom; the general theorems have empty dependencies. 3 application examples are not counted. Independent review completed (EVALUATOR-GROUNDING-REVIEW.md): inferences and recheck accepted, step one narrowed, tolerance's defence not accepted; its 15 corrections are applied, and the checker was rerun after the Lean documentation was corrected.

Yields positive significance, not weight, permission, duty or ranking, and predicts no recognition or compliance. Universality is limited to evaluators holding S0 and accepting unrestricted monotonicity (with BI) and tolerance; S0 cannot be derived for every possible evaluator; tolerance is not defended against the closure-coordinate and zero-reaching-weight rivals. Content scope is the kind of living S0 attaches to; positive significance of all organization formation and the value of bringing new lives into existence are not derived.

- A present-aim evaluator without self-significance satisfies monotonicity, supervenience and tolerance yet assigns no significance; the conclusion does not hold for every possible evaluator. [EvaluatorGrounding.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/generative-capacity/EvaluatorGrounding.lean)
- A threshold rival satisfies self-significance, monotonicity and supervenience, reaches the formed other but not the stranger, and violates tolerance exactly at its cut. [EvaluatorGrounding.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/generative-capacity/EvaluatorGrounding.lean)
- Closed self: the threshold rival with its step relation restricted to its own positive region; it shows Chain carries weight for that step relation, not that M1 does. Parfitian continuity and autopoietic closure are isomorphic monist formations. [EvaluatorGrounding.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/generative-capacity/EvaluatorGrounding.lean)
- In profile2 with the product order every standpoint escapes step one, including a balanced generative evaluator; a weighted order needs 7a ≤ 5b. Step one binds generative self-good led by formative contribution that accepts unrestricted monotonicity. [EvaluatorGrounding.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/generative-capacity/EvaluatorGrounding.lean)
- Closure-coordinate rival: with a formed closure coordinate in the profile, self-significance, unrestricted monotonicity, supervenience and stepwise tolerance hold while Diff and Chain fail; it is not ownership in disguise. [EVALUATOR-GROUNDING-REVIEW.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/EVALUATOR-GROUNDING-REVIEW.md)
- Own-restricted monotonicity is consistent with self-significance, supervenience, own-only significance and Diff; step one's exact inconsistency holds only for a rival granting HUIGEN §7's first horn. [EVALUATOR-GROUNDING-REVIEW.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/EVALUATOR-GROUNDING-REVIEW.md)
- A graded weight falling continuously to zero at a finite distance: bounded change per step, yet no significance far away; the cut need not lie at the own boundary. [EVALUATOR-GROUNDING-REVIEW.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/EVALUATOR-GROUNDING-REVIEW.md)

<a id="依赖与关联-dependencies-and-related-results"></a>
## Dependencies and related results

- **formal-reuse**: [positive-ground-open-futures](positive-ground-open-futures.md). reach_is_g0 and self_good_derives_reachable_g0 conclude the same GenerativeComparison.G0 predicate; this result supplies a derivation from S0 of that predicate on the reachable inventory, without changing the earlier proof or scope.

**Output:** For an S0-holding position, G0 holds on the reachable inventory with its significance as positive relevance.

**Input:** The G0 hypothesis of contingent_generation_has_positive_ground.

**Preserved conditions:** Inventory restricted to living content reachable by the position, with a single history (Unit), so the branching structure of open futures is not represented; positive relevance is the position's significance; tolerance and graded connection hold. [EvaluatorGrounding.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/generative-capacity/EvaluatorGrounding.lean)

- Related, not a proved adapter: [positioned-positive-reason](positioned-positive-reason.md). That result shows endorsement independence comes from D. This route replaces D with endorsement of S0, tolerance (and BI), so it does not obtain endorsement-independent force: a position is committed to this instance only if it accepts S0, tolerance (and BI). The Universal Metaethical Core locates endorsement independence in the externalist articulation A.
- Related, not a proved adapter: [universal-practical-warrant](universal-practical-warrant.md). Advances without completing it: universality is limited to S0-holding evaluators, and step two relies on tolerance; present-aim evaluators are not bound.
- Related, not a proved adapter: [alignment-direction-g0-j](alignment-direction-g0-j.md). Interpretive connection: an AI with non-instrumental generative self-good as part of its aims is argument-reachable, but step one first extends to its own copies and successors, favouring its lineage and not by itself reaching humans; positivity carries no weight and is compatible with strong lineage bias. A merely instrumentally self-preserving system is not reachable; its alignment rests on design and governance.
- Related, not a proved adapter: [metaethical-core-characterization](metaethical-core-characterization.md). The P+ version of step two that the review requested is that result's N_rel: transmission along nonzero formed relations, over actual relations rather than possible profiles; BI is an instance of N_rel and the standpoint-to-normative bridge is N_std. This result is the first-personal source of the seed. No formal adapter between the modules is established.
